summary: Two EPCSAR members climbing Mt. Shavano/Tabeguache encountered an injured runner at ~14,150 ft just below the Shavano summit; worked with a Vail Mountain Rescue member; South Chaffee Rescue commanded; splinted and escorted to LZ 700 ft below; flown out by Reach Air Medical.
notes: Source: El Paso County SAR Facebook page. Chaffee County incident; EPCSAR members assisted. Agencies: South Chaffee Rescue (command), EPCSAR, Vail Mountain Rescue, Reach Air Medical.
